fullPassage: Harvard business professor Alison Wood Brooks has done studies that show how stress and anxiety change based on what we tell ourselves. Brooks's experiment sounds like a blast or a nightmare, depending on your perspective. She took a group of subjects with stage fright to a crowded bar with a stage and had them get up there and sing. All the subjects arrived nervous, as expected. But Brooks measured whether or not having them change their language — calling their nerves "excitement" — made any difference. She had one nervous group tell themselves over and over, "I am excited," and tested them against a control group who just sat with their nerves and their regular self-talk. The results were eye-opening. The decision to tell themselves that the feeling they were experiencing was excitement helped them convert the energy into something positive, even useful.

ch: based on what we tell ourselves

questions.passage: Harvard business professor Alison Wood Brooks has done studies that show how stress and anxiety change based on what we tell ourselves. Brooks's experiment sounds like a blast or a nightmare, depending on your perspective. She took a group of subjects with stage fright to a crowded bar with a stage and had them get up there and sing. All the subjects arrived nervous, as expected. But Brooks measured whether or not having them change their language — calling their nerves "excitement" — made any difference. She had one nervous group tell themselves over and over, "I am excited," and tested them against a control group who just sat with their nerves and their regular self-talk. The results were eye-opening. The decision to tell themselves that the feeling they were experiencing was excitement helped them convert the energy into __________, even useful.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 흥분이라고 스스로에게 말하기로 한 결정이 에너지를 긍정적인 것(something positive)으로 전환하는 데 도움이 되었다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① something negative — 부정적인 것 (문맥 반대: 에너지를 긍정적으로 전환)
❌ ② their regular self-talk — 평소 혼잣말 (통제집단의 행동이지 전환 결과 아님)
✅ ③ something positive — 긍정적인 것 ←정답
❌ ④ a blast or a nightmare — 폭발적이거나 악몽 (실험 설명이지 전환 결과 아님)
det.tip: convert the energy into something positive = 에너지를 긍정적인 것으로 전환
